articles.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
articles.snippet: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.

articles.title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
articles.snippet: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.

articles.title: U.S. Treasury moves to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
articles.snippet: Treasury billed the move as part of its campaign against Iran, but the order rests on MEXC's alleged role in Russian illicit finance.

articles.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.
